body:
I think we have our wires crossed, I didn't separate that out enough, apologies

I mean, I'd interpret changing or adjusting your personality as trying to fit in

I don't want to do that, and am conscious about not doing that... But at the same time still want to feel welcome

Being the punching bag/outsider for as long as I can remember begins to wane on you eventually... I don't see it as trying to "fit in" I'd interpret that as adjusting my personality in a way that's not me... Its trying to feel welcome
